notes.title: New Playtest Available!
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share that the [b]first publicly available build of [i]Biathlon Challenge[/i][/b] is now live! 🏔️🔫⛷️[/p][p align="start"]Here’s what’s waiting for you in this early build:[/p][list][*][p][b]3 unique guns[/b] to master[/p][/*][*][p][b]7 items [/b]to customize your playstyle[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 characters [/b]with different physics and stats[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 sliding implements[/b] to tackle the terrain[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 courses[/b] across The Lodge's backyard and beyond.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b] for each course—the top spot is up for grabs!
[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45785054/4c66856f917784e8381049534f036c0f48d0bbba.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]🔓 Unlock new gear and courses as you progress, and don’t forget to keep your eyes open—there are [b]secrets hidden throughout the world[/b] for the most observant challengers.[/p][p align="start"]We are looking forward to your feedback- More to come![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]-jc[/p]

notes.title: Here we GO!
notes.content:
